about: Read the photo (#198, #249): the most of each unit a recipe line plausibly asks for. A photo-read line whose leading amount is above its unit's maximum ('34 tsp salt', '23 cups oats', '18 tsp nutmeg': a fraction glyph read as digits) is listed under Check these lines, flagged only: nothing is suggested or corrected, and the scaler reads the number as written. Keyed by the unit the language's units.json names the unit word as (MeasureUnit), so it is language-independent; a unit not listed (VARIES) and a bare count ('12 eggs') are never checked. Calibrated so no ingredient line in the repo's fixtures and saved pages is flagged (docs/decisions.md, #249). Applies to photo-read lines only, never to a parsed web recipe.
